EEB Research Day 2026 - Streamertail Clines
Code adapted from Aguillon et al. (2022)


```{r}
#loading packages

library("tidyverse")
library("nlstools")
library("geosphere")
library("sf")
library("ggplot2")
library("mapview")

```


```{r}
#loading and subsetting datasets

locations <- read.csv("C:/Users/matil/OneDrive/Desktop/Aguillon Lab/Gary + LSU Scorings.xlsx - M&F.csv")

red.prop.dorsal <- read.csv("C:/Users/matil/OneDrive/Desktop/dorsal recolorize/updated.dorsal.red.prop.df.csv")

dorsal.cline.df <- as.data.frame(cbind(red.prop.dorsal$samples..AS.THEY.APPEAR.IN.MASTER.GOOGLE.SHEETS., red.prop.dorsal$red.prop, locations$LONG_DEC, locations$LAT_DEC, locations$CORRECT_NUMERIC_SITES))
colnames(dorsal.cline.df) <- c("ID NUMBER", "PROP.RED", "LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE", "SITES")
dorsal.cline.df <- dorsal.cline.df[!is.na(dorsal.cline.df$LONGITUDE), ]
dorsal.cline.df <- dorsal.cline.df[!is.na(dorsal.cline.df$PROP.RED), ]

dorsal.cline.df$SITES <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$SITES)
dorsal.cline.df$PROP.RED <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$PROP.RED)
dorsal.cline.df$LONGITUDE <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$LONGITUDE)
dorsal.cline.df$LATITUDE <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$LATITUDE)

```


```{r}
#summarizing lat, long, and phenotype by site

cline_summary <- dorsal.cline.df |>
  group_by(SITES)|>
  summarize(samples = n(),
            red.prop_mean = mean(PROP.RED),
            red.prop_se = sd(PROP.RED/12)/samples,
            long_mean = mean(LONGITUDE),
            lat_mean = mean(LATITUDE)) |>
  arrange(SITES)

cline_summary

```


```{r}
#calculating the distance between sites

mlat <- mean(cline_summary$lat_mean)

s1 <- c(cline_summary$long_mean[1], mlat)

distance <- c()
for(i in 1:nrow(cline_summary)){
  distance[i] <- distm(s1, c(cline_summary$long_mean[i], mlat))/1000
}
distance

```


```{r}
#mapping & adding distance into the data frame

cline_summary$mlat <- rep(mlat, times = 12)

mapview(cline_summary, xcol = "long_mean", ycol = "lat_mean", col.regions = c("darkgreen"), crs = 4269, grid = FALSE) +
  mapview(cline_summary, xcol = "long_mean", ycol = "mlat", col.regions = c("red"), crs = 4269, grid = FALSE)

cline_summary$distance <- distance

```


```{r}
#evaluating phenotype

max_value <- 1
rhs <- function(x, c, w) {
  max_value/(1+exp((4*(x-c))/w))
}

phenotype_model <- nls(red.prop_mean ~ rhs(distance, center, width),
                 data = cline_summary,
                 start = list(center = max(cline_summary$distance)/2, width = max(cline_summary$distance)/2),
                 control = list(maxiter = 500),
                 trace = T)

```


```{r}

summary(phenotype_model)
phenotype_summary <- summary(phenotype_model)
coef(phenotype_model)

```


```{r}

#CI_phenotype_model <- confint(phenotype_model, parm = c("center", "width"))

boot_CI_phenotype_model <- nlsBoot(phenotype_model, niter = 999)

```


```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(data=cline_summary,aes(x=distance,y=red.prop_mean,ymin=red.prop_mean-red.prop_se,ymax=red.prop_mean+red.prop_se),color="black",shape=16) +
  geom_smooth(data=cline_summary, aes(x=distance,y=red.prop_mean), method="nls", formula=y~1/(1+exp((4*(x-c))/w)), se=FALSE, method.args=list(start=list(c=max(cline_summary$distance)/2,w=max(cline_summary$distance)/2)), color="black") +
  ylim(c(-0.01,1.3)) +
  xlim(c(0,max(cline_summary$distance))) +
  xlab("Distance (km)") +
  ylab("Proportion of Red") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12), axis.text=element_text(size=10,color="black"))
  #geom_rect(aes(xmin = boot_CI_phenotype_model[1,1], xmax = boot_CI_phenotype_model[1,2], ymin = 1.1, ymax = 1.2), fill = NA, color = "black") + geom_segment(aes(x = phenotype_summary$parameters[1,1], y = 1.1, yend = 1.2), color = "black", lwd = 1)


```


```{r}
#cline without Location 1: cline summary

dorsal.cline.df_minus1 <- dorsal.cline.df[dorsal.cline.df$SITES != 1, ]
cline_summary_minus1 <- dorsal.cline.df_minus1 |>
  group_by(SITES)|>
  summarize(samples = n(),
            red.prop_mean = mean(PROP.RED),
            red.prop_se = sd(PROP.RED)/samples,
            long_mean = mean(LONGITUDE),
            lat_mean = mean(LATITUDE)) |>
  arrange(SITES)

cline_summary_minus1

```


```{r}
#cline without Location 1: finding distances

mlat_minus1 <- mean(cline_summary_minus1$lat_mean)

s2 <- c(cline_summary_minus1$long_mean[1], mlat_minus1)

distance_minus1 <- c()
for(i in 1:nrow(cline_summary_minus1)){
  distance_minus1[i] <- distm(s2, c(cline_summary_minus1$long_mean[i], mlat_minus1))/1000
}
distance_minus1

```



```{r}
#cline without Location 1: mapping distances

cline_summary_minus1$mlat_minus1 <- rep(mlat_minus1, times = 11)

mapview(cline_summary_minus1, xcol = "long_mean", ycol = "lat_mean", col.regions = c("darkgreen"), crs = 4269, grid = FALSE) +
  mapview(cline_summary_minus1, xcol = "long_mean", ycol = "mlat_minus1", col.regions = c("red"), crs = 4269, grid = FALSE)

cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1 <- distance_minus1

```


```{r}
#cline without Location 1: making cline

ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(data=cline_summary_minus1,aes(x=distance_minus1,y=red.prop_mean,ymin=red.prop_mean-red.prop_se,ymax=red.prop_mean+red.prop_se),color="black",shape=16) +
  #geom_smooth(data=cline_summary_minus1, aes(x=distance_minus1,y=red.prop_mean), method="nls", formula=y~1/(1+exp((4*(x-c))/w)), se=FALSE, method.args=list(start=list(c=max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1)/2,w=max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1)/2)), color="black") +
  ylim(c(-0.01,1.0)) +
  xlim(c(0,max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1))) +
  xlab("Distance (km)") +
  ylab("Proportion of Red") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12), axis.text=element_text(size=10,color="black"))

```


```{r}

cline_summary_minus1$max_red <- cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean/(max(cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean))

ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(data=cline_summary_minus1,aes(x=distance_minus1,y=max_red,ymin=max_red-red.prop_se,ymax=max_red+red.prop_se),color="black",shape=16) +
  geom_smooth(data=cline_summary_minus1, aes(x=distance_minus1,y=max_red), method="nls", formula=y~1/(1+exp((4*(x-c))/w)), se=FALSE, method.args=list(start=list(c=max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1),w=max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1))), color="black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) x*(max(cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean)), 
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25/max(cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean), 0.5/max(cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean), 0.75/max(cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean), 1/max(cline_summary_minus1$red.prop_mean))) +
  xlim(c(0,max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1))) +
  xlab("Distance (km)") +
  ylab("Proportion of Red") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12), axis.text=element_text(size=10,color="black"))


```



```{r}
#VENTRAL RECOLORIZE

red.prop.ventral.RECOLORIZE <- read.csv("C:/Users/matil/OneDrive/Desktop/ventral recolorize/updated.four.color.ventral.red.prop.df.csv")

ventral.cline.df <- as.data.frame(cbind(red.prop.ventral.RECOLORIZE$samples..AS.THEY.APPEAR.IN.MASTER.GOOGLE.SHEETS., red.prop.ventral.RECOLORIZE$red.prop))
ventral.cline.df <- ventral.cline.df[1:204, ]
colnames(ventral.cline.df) <- c("ID NUMBER", "PROP.RED")
ventral.cline.df$LONGITUDE <- locations$LONG_DEC
ventral.cline.df$LATITUDE <- locations$LAT_DEC
ventral.cline.df$SITES <- locations$CORRECT_NUMERIC_SITES

ventral.cline.df <- ventral.cline.df[!is.na(ventral.cline.df$LONGITUDE), ]
ventral.cline.df <- ventral.cline.df[!is.na(ventral.cline.df$PROP.RED), ]

ventral.cline.df$SITES <- as.numeric(ventral.cline.df$SITES)
ventral.cline.df$PROP.RED <- as.numeric(ventral.cline.df$PROP.RED)
ventral.cline.df$LONGITUDE <- as.numeric(ventral.cline.df$LONGITUDE)
ventral.cline.df$LATITUDE <- as.numeric(ventral.cline.df$LATITUDE)

ventral.cline.df <- ventral.cline.df[ventral.cline.df$SITES != 1, ]
ventral_cline_summary <- ventral.cline.df |>
  group_by(SITES)|>
  summarize(samples = n(),
            red.prop_mean = mean(PROP.RED),
            red.prop_se = sd(PROP.RED)/samples,
            long_mean = mean(LONGITUDE),
            lat_mean = mean(LATITUDE)) |>
  arrange(SITES)
ventral_cline_summary$distance_minus1 <- distance_minus1[c(1:8, 10:11)]


ventral_cline_summary$max_red <- ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean/(max(ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean))

ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(data=ventral_cline_summary,aes(x=distance_minus1,y=max_red,ymin=max_red-red.prop_se,ymax=max_red+red.prop_se),color="black",shape=16) +
  geom_smooth(data=ventral_cline_summary, aes(x=distance_minus1,y=max_red), method="nls", formula=y~1/(1+exp((4*(x-c))/w)), se=FALSE, method.args=list(start=list(c=max(ventral_cline_summary$distance_minus1),w=max(ventral_cline_summary$distance_minus1))), color="black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) x*(max(ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean)), 
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25/max(ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean), 0.5/max(ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean), 0.75/max(ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean), 1/max(ventral_cline_summary$red.prop_mean))) +
  xlim(c(0,max(ventral_cline_summary$distance_minus1))) +
  xlab("Distance (km)") +
  ylab("Proportion of Red") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12), axis.text=element_text(size=10,color="black"))


```

```{r}
max_value_minus1 <- 1
rhs_minus1 <- function(x, c, w) {
  max_value_minus1/(1+exp((4*(x-c))/w))
}

phenotype_model_minus1 <- nls(red.prop_mean ~ rhs_minus1(distance, center, width),
                 data = cline_summary_minus1,
                 start = list(center = max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1)/2, width = max(cline_summary_minus1$distance_minus1)/2),
                 control = list(maxiter = 500),
                 trace = T)


summary(phenotype_model_minus1)
phenotype_summary_minus1 <- summary(phenotype_model_minus1)
coef(phenotype_model_minus1)


boot_CI_phenotype_model_minus1 <- nlsBoot(phenotype_model_minus1, niter = 999)
```
